title: Trace the model across its artifact boundary
description: Select a source framework and a production target, then add model-specific hazards. The result is relative effort points, not a fabricated migration timeline.

frameworks.label: TensorFlow
frameworks.nativeArtifact: Keras export or SavedModel-derived target artifact

frameworks.label: JAX
frameworks.nativeArtifact: Transformed Python program or supported exported lowering

targets.label: Managed Python service
targets.detail: The framework runtime can be installed and operated with the model.

cautions.pytorch: Own eager or compiled fallback behavior.
cautions.jax: Own compilation cache, sharding, and service lifecycle.

targets.label: Mobile or embedded runtime
targets.detail: The model must lower to a supported device backend without a full training runtime.

cautions.pytorch: Check ExecuTorch operator and backend partitions.
cautions.tensorflow: Check Lite conversion, delegates, and operator support.
cautions.jax: Prove a supported consuming runtime before choosing this path.

targets.label: Multi-host accelerator mesh
targets.detail: Global arrays, collectives, resharding, and host-local data must be explicit.

cautions.pytorch: Validate FSDP or distributed strategy and checkpoints.
cautions.tensorflow: Validate distribution strategy and input ownership.
cautions.jax: Validate mesh, NamedSharding, collectives, and host-local inputs.

targets.label: Non-Python server runtime
targets.detail: A separately owned runtime consumes an exported model contract.

cautions.pytorch: Choose and verify the actual export consumer.
cautions.jax: Confirm the exported lowering has a supported consumer and lifecycle.

modifiers.label: Unsupported operators
modifiers.detail: Some model operations cannot lower to the selected target and need replacement or fallback.

modifiers.label: Custom kernels
modifiers.detail: The model depends on target-specific compiled code with its own build and compatibility surface.

modifiers.label: Numerical sensitivity
modifiers.detail: Small precision or ordering differences can cross a product decision threshold.
